exercises.instruction: Переведите предложения на английский язык, используя must, mustn’t, had to и don’t need to. (день рождения = birthday; вести себя тихо = be quiet)

items.prompt: Я должна позвонить матери. Сегодня её день рождения.
answers: I must phone my mother. It’s her birthday today.
I must phone my mother. It is her birthday today.
I must call my mother. It’s her birthday today.
I must call my mother. It is her birthday today.
I must ring my mother. It’s her birthday today.
I must ring my mother. It is her birthday today.

items.prompt: Это важная встреча. Ты не должен опаздывать!
answers: It’s an important meeting. You mustn’t be late!

It is an important meeting. You mustn’t be late!
It is an important meeting. You must not be late!

items.prompt: Ты должен прочитать её новую книгу!
answers: You must read her new book!
